 What our Post expert thinks about Timberwolves vs. Heat
 The Antetokounmpo saga took nearly two years to settle, but he finally landed with the Heat after months of speculation. The two-time MVP pairs up with Erik Spoelstra, one of the top coaches in the NBA, as he looks to bring the Heat another ring. 
 When the Timberwolves acquired Ball, head coach Chris Finch said the team “traded moodiness for giddiness.” Ball’s unconventional playing style has led to tons of highlight plays, but this will be his first real crack at playing on a winning team with expectations to compete for a championship .
